purpose: Pinned upstream provenance for the New Path D2-derived equipment engine. Source mechanics are reimplemented; upstream GPL source is not vendored here.

files.role: item serialization, quality, durability, sockets, requirements, set/runeword/property behavior
item object API, canEquip, defense, durability, set attributes, sockets, runewords
equipped-item aggregation and character item state
paperdoll interaction, sockets, equipped-item UI state
armor base records: defense, requirements, durability, sockets, tiers and appearance components
weapon base records: damage, requirements, durability, sockets, tiers and weapon classes
set-piece base properties and per-piece partial-set bonuses
set-wide partial and full set bonuses
runeword eligibility, ordered rune recipes and granted properties
save-level equipment location, quality, durability, sockets and set-bonus bit semantics

adoption_rule: Preserve D2 item/equipment state semantics wherever they are system-agnostic. Translate only terminal numeric combat effects into New Path 3.5e/GURPS/fused outputs. Extend slots and requirements only where campaign physicality needs states D2 does not represent.
